sn47.3:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn47.3:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
sn47.3:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn47.3:1.4: evameva panidhekacce moghapurisā maññeva ajjhesanti dhamme ca bhāsite mameva anubandhitabbaṃ maññantīti.
sn47.3:1.5: desetu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ appeva nāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ appeva nāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.
sn47.3:1.6: tasmā tiha tvaṃ bhikkhu ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
sn47.3:1.8: sīlaṃ ca suvisuddhaṃ diṭṭhi ca ujukā.
sn47.3:1.9: yato kho te bhikkhu sīlaṃ ca suvisuddhaṃ bhavissati diṭṭhi ca ujukā. tato tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne tividhena bhāveyyāsi.
sn47.3:2.2: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.3: bahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.4: ajjhattabahiddhā vā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.7: ajjhattabahiddhā vā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.10: ajjhattabahiddhā vā citte cittānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.13: ajjhattabahiddhā vā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.14: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ tividhena bhāvessasi. tato tuyhaṃ bhikkhu yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuḍḍhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti.
sn47.3:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn47.3:3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariya pariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhaññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
sn47.3:3.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn47.3:3.4: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
